plan_item: C5 (whole-network plan, DEC 2026-10-28 Batch A D15 overridden); bar = S1 pre-registration section 9.7 (R23)
registered: 2026-10-28, before any C5 student was scored on a held-out row

splits.test: ClickHouse cityHash64(key) % 5 == 0  (S1 9.7; key = child_did for pairs, did for profiles, toString(community) for communities)
splits.test_use: scored once, by the final model chosen on val; never used for training, early stopping, threshold or model selection
splits.sanity_mode: --sanity drops every test row before anything is read further and carves a pseudo-test from val, so a local smoke run never touches the held-out split

pairs: parent or child author in the S5 hide-from-recs union or the user-intents opt-outs (amendment A1: their posts are excluded from the teacher and from training)
parent or child author flagged likely_minors by Haiku or Sonnet, or whose labelled community carries likely_minors in community_labels_v2 (union rule, DEC 2026-10-28 round-2 entry)
profiles: likely_minors by Haiku or Sonnet, or community carrying likely_minors (minors rule)
rows without a Claude account type
communities: communities whose v2 label carries likely_minors

input = the Opus prompt cut before 'Sample recent original posts by members:' (posts are not attributed to authors in the prompt, so the A1 post filter cannot be applied to them; they are dropped instead)

labels.hostile: sonnet_stance == 'hostile' (binary); Haiku comparison only where haiku_stance exists (round-1 pairs)
labels.account_type: Sonnet where present, else Haiku (Sonnet is the teacher wherever both exist)

inputs.pairs: tokenizer text pair: ('reply: ' | 'quote: ') + parent_text, child_text. block_after is never an input
inputs.communities: Opus prompt up to the posts section

model.head: mean-pooled last hidden state -> dropout 0.1 -> linear; full fine-tune

training.loss: cross-entropy with inverse-sqrt-frequency class weights (train split)
training.selection: best epoch by val metric: hostile kappa (stance task), macro-F1 (type tasks)
training.hostile_threshold: P(hostile) >= t, t from 0.05..0.95 step 0.05 maximising val kappa

metrics.bootstrap: 2,000 percentile resamples, numpy default_rng(20261028), 95% CI; resampling unit = child author for pairs (cluster bootstrap), row for profiles and communities
metrics.macro_f1: over the fixed teacher class list; a class with 2TP+FP+FN = 0 in a resample scores 0

bars.hostile_learnable: ALL of: (1) student kappa vs Sonnet on the full held-out split >= 0.6; (2) on the held-out pairs that have a Haiku label, the 95% CI lower bound of the student's kappa > Haiku-vs-Sonnet kappa on those same pairs
bars.account_type_learnable: held-out macro-F1 vs the Claude label (Sonnet else Haiku), 95% CI lower bound >= 0.6; Sonnet-only subset and Haiku-vs-Sonnet on it reported alongside
bars.community_type_learnable: held-out macro-F1 vs the Opus label, 95% CI lower bound >= 0.6
bars.c6_gate: C6 may be asked only if hostile_learnable is true

units.self_stop: before each epoch, units so far (wall time since the job started + preamble allowance) plus the projected next epoch must stay <= cap; otherwise training stops and the best checkpoint so far is scored
